name: Create a real client and reload its persistent record
description: Creates a real client record in the server database and verifies it remains after reload.
steps: Sign in as Dewulf.denis@gmail.com
Open Clients and create a client with name and city
Reload the app and reopen Clients
expected: The created client remains visible from the server database and no demo clients are shown.

name: Create an audit and retain checklist changes
description: Creates an audit for a saved client and persists its checklist changes.
steps: Open a saved client and create a new audit
Open the audit and check several manual controls
Reload and reopen the audit
expected: The audit and checked controls remain saved in the server database.

name: Run and save a real Lighthouse website scan
description: Runs PageSpeed Insights against a public client website and saves the measured results.
steps: Create a client with a valid public HTTPS website
Create an audit for that client
Launch the real analysis and reload the audit
expected: The audit shows measured Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO scores with dated findings returned by PageSpeed Insights; results persist after reload.

name: Reject invalid URLs and unauthorized API access
description: Verifies the app rejects invalid scan URLs and denies API requests without an authorized admin session.
steps: Try to save a client with an invalid website URL
Sign out
Attempt to request client or audit data while signed out
expected: Invalid URLs are rejected, protected API calls are denied, and private client data is not returned.

name: Use audit workflow on a narrow iPhone
description: Exercises client creation, audit creation and detail views on a mobile viewport.
steps: Sign in on a mobile viewport
Create a client and an audit
Open its detail and scroll the audit table inside its own container
expected: Forms and reports fit the viewport, the bottom navigation respects the iPhone safe area, and only the table scrolls horizontally.

name: Enrich audit from public sources
covers: Jina Reader public website and social discovery
description: Enriches an audit with public business, domain and website data.
steps: Sign in and create an audit with a public website
Open the audit and select Enrichir avec les données publiques
Review sources and caveats
expected: Available results are saved with source labels and limitations; missing information is not fabricated.

name: Configure API preferences and create a one-page PDF
description: Configures optional API keys locally and prints a concise report.
steps: Open Settings and enter optional restricted Google API keys
Save settings, then clear them
Open an audit and choose PDF client · 1 page
expected: Keys remain only in this browser local storage and can be cleared. The print dialog opens a compact A4 report without application navigation.
